basic_info.description: The ADS1675 is a high-speed, high-precision 24-bit analog-to-digital converter with 103dB dynamic range at 4MSPS and 111dB at 125kSPS. It features a dual-path programmable digital filter with selectable Low-Latency or Wide-Bandwidth paths, operates from +5V analog and +3V digital supplies, and supports both CMOS and LVDS serial interfaces. Designed for automated test equipment, medical imaging, and scientific instrumentation.

features: 4MSPS, 24-bit analog-to-digital converter with 103dB dynamic range at 4MSPS and 111dB at 125kSPS
Dual-path programmable digital filter with selectable Low-Latency or Wide-Bandwidth paths
Low-Latency filter settles in as fast as 2.65ms
Wide-Bandwidth path provides 1.7MHz bandwidth with flat passband ripple (< ±0.00002dB) and 86dB stopband attenuation
Flexible read-only serial interface supporting standard CMOS and LVDS logic levels
Direct control via START pin for conversion initiation
Out-of-range detection for both analog and digital filters
Fully specified over industrial temperature range (-40°C to +85°C)

pin_configuration.name: VCM
pin_configuration.description: Terminal for external bypass capacitor connection to internal common-mode voltage

pin_configuration.name: RSV2
pin_configuration.description: Reserved, short pin to digital ground

pin_configuration.name: RSV1
pin_configuration.description: Reserved, short pin to digital supply

pin_configuration.name: SCLK_SEL
pin_configuration.description: Shift-clock source select. If SCLK_SEL = '0', then SCLK is internally generated. If SCLK_SEL = '1', then SCLK must be externally generated.

pin_configuration.name: LVDS
pin_configuration.description: Serial interface select. If LVDS = '0', then interface is LVDS-compatible. If LVDS = '1', then interface is CMOS-compatible.

pin_configuration.name: LL_CONFIG
pin_configuration.description: Configure Low-Latency digital filter. If LL_CONFIG = '0', then single-cycle settling is selected. If LL_CONFIG = '1', then fast-response is selected.

pin_configuration.name: FPATH
pin_configuration.description: Digital filter path selection. If FPATH = '0', then path is Wide-Bandwidth. If FPATH = '1', then path is Low-Latency.

pin_configuration.name: START
pin_configuration.description: Start convert, reset, and synchronization control input

pin_configuration.name: SCLK
pin_configuration.description: Negative shift clock output. If SCLK_SEL = '0', then SCLK is the complementary shift clock output. If SCLK_SEL = '1', then SCLK always output is 3-state.

pin_configuration.name: SCLK
pin_configuration.description: Positive shift clock output. If SCLK_SEL = '0', then SCLK is an output. If SCLK_SEL = '1', then SCLK is an input.

pin_configuration.name: VREFN
pin_configuration.description: Negative reference voltage. Short to analog ground
